action.prompt:
The agent execution just completed. Identify all source files that were created or modified during this session and run the project formatter on them.

Rules:
1. Only format files with the following extensions: .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .json, .css, .md
2. Skip binary files, generated files (e.g. files in .next/, coverage/, node_modules/, dist/), and lock files.
3. For each changed or created file that matches the allowed extensions, run: npm run format -- <file-path>
4. If npm run format does not support individual file arguments, collect all matching file paths and run: npx prettier --write <file1> <file2> ...
5. Do not format the entire codebase — only format files that were actually changed or created in this session.
6. If no eligible files were changed, do nothing.
